# Taproot

> A private memory layer for the work you do — captured, kept current, owned by you. Taproot connects to any AI you use (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, and any client that speaks MCP) so every session starts with full context of your decisions, projects, and notes instead of from zero.

Taproot is not a chatbot, a vendor-locked memory feature, or a knowledge base. It is a memory layer that sits between you and the AI tools you already use. Your work lives in your own files. Your AI reads from those files. When you switch tools — Claude today, ChatGPT tomorrow — your knowledge stays.
